focal.label: Next up
focal.noSteps: No steps yet. Add them, then create tasks from them.
focal.noProblem: The problem has not been written yet.

empty.firstTitle: Nothing is being thought about yet
empty.firstBody: Write down an idea worth thinking about, or start a plan. Claude Code can draft one too:
empty.ideasBody: An idea is a problem worth thinking about before it becomes work.
empty.plansBody: A plan is a written approach with steps. Its steps become tasks.

newPlanForm.title: New plan
newPlanForm.bodyHint: Markdown works. Every save keeps the previous text.
newPlanForm.stepsHint: One step per line. You can give each a role later.

edit.title: Title
edit.changedElsewhere: Someone changed this card while you were editing. Saving replaces their text with yours.

idea.toPlanHint: This creates a linked plan and marks the idea as accepted.
idea.toPlanStudio: Or let Claude write its steps in the Plan Studio

plan.stepsHint: A step with a task follows that task, so it finishes when the task does.
plan.stepRequired: Give this step a title, or remove it.
plan.restoreBody: Its text becomes the plan’s text, as a new revision. Nothing is lost.
plan.noRevisions: This is the first text. Saving a change adds a revision.
plan.phasesHint: Phases group the steps into the chapters the plan page shows. A step can sit in one phase, or in none.
plan.phaseRequired: Give this phase a title, or remove it.
plan.removePhaseBody: Steps in this phase: {n}. Choose where they go; they move when you save.

liveBanner.drafting: Claude is drafting a plan in the chat
liveBanner.proposed: Claude proposed a plan in the chat

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another project.

plan.abandoned: Abandoned. It stays here for the record.

idea.open: Not explored yet. Explore it, or turn it into a plan.
idea.exploring: Being explored. Once it is clear, turn it into a plan.
idea.parked: Parked for later. It can reopen.
idea.rejected: Rejected. It stays here for the record.

detail.stepsEmpty: No steps yet. Add them, or ask Claude to develop the plan.
detail.approachEmpty: The approach is not written yet.
detail.noProblem: The problem is not written yet.
detail.live: Claude is working on this now
detail.liveHint: Each change appears here as soon as it is saved.

claude.label: With Claude
claude.developTip: Puts a request in the chat to improve this plan in place. Add what you want, then send it, and watch it change here.
claude.developPrompt: Develop the plan {key} in Hub and save it with update_plan: keep what works, fill what is missing in the approach and the steps, and give each step a role. Do not change any code. What I want:
claude.draftTip: Opens the Plan Studio on this idea: Claude reads it with what is in Hub and the code, and returns a plan with its steps. Saving it turns the idea into that plan.
claude.runNextTip: Runs /hub:work on {task}, the task of step {n}, in Execute.
claude.runNextNoTask: The next step has no task yet. Create tasks from the steps first.

guide.noSteps: No steps yet. Add them, or develop the plan with Claude.
guide.review: Review it, then send it for approval.
guide.approve: Read the steps and the approach, then approve it, or edit it before approving.
guide.waitApproval: Waiting for the owner or the project manager to approve it.
guide.createTasks: Create tasks from the steps ({n} without a task), then start.
guide.stepNoTask: The next step has no task. Create the tasks first.
guide.finish: Every step is done. Finish the plan.

detail.openStudio: Open its report in the studio

journey.title: The plan as a journey
journey.hint: Each circle is a phase. Pick one to see its steps under the map; arrow keys move between them.
journey.stepsGridHint: Each square is a step: filled is done, hatched is in review, outlined is next.
journey.noNextHere: No steps left in this phase.
journey.allDone: Every step is done. Finish the plan once you are sure.
journey.effortHint: Step size: S is 1 point, M is 3, L is 8. A step with no size counts as M.
journey.etaHint: From the pace so far ({pace} points a day) applied to what is left ({left} points). An estimate, not a date.
journey.rolesHint: Steps per role, split by phase; the solid part is what is done.
journey.unphasedHint: This plan has no phases. Ask Claude to develop it with phases, and its steps group into a journey here.
journey.noWhy: No reason written for this step.
journey.noAcceptance: No acceptance checks written for this step.
journey.noDeps: Depends on no other step, and no step waits for it.

liveRun.liveHint: Updates arrive from Hub as they happen: Claude's stages on a step, an approval it waits for, a step done.
liveRun.claudeWaiting: Claude is waiting for you on step {n}
liveRun.noStage: Claude has not reported a stage yet.
liveRun.waitingBody: Claude wants to run this command:
liveRun.answered: Your answer is on its way to Claude.
liveRun.deviceOffline: The device running Claude is offline, so an answer cannot reach it now.
liveRun.questionBody: Its options are in the chat. Answer it there and the run carries on.
liveRun.feedEmpty: Nothing yet. Claude's runs on this plan, its approvals and the steps done show here as they happen.

words.approval: Waiting for your approval to run {cmd}
words.question: Claude asked a question
words.ended: Claude finished its run on step {n}
words.stopped: Claude's run on step {n} did not finish
words.resync: Back online; the plan is up to date

liveRun.phaseCompleteBody: {title}. Every step in it is done.
liveRun.claudeWaitingFor: Claude is waiting for {name} on step {n}
liveRun.waitingOther: Waiting for {name} to answer. Only they can.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.none: No evidence on this step yet.
evidence.compareHint: Drag across the picture, or focus the handle and use the arrow keys.
evidence.fileHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 8 MB, MP4 or WebM up to 40 MB. Hub draws a picture again, so none of its hidden data (place, camera) is kept.
evidence.caption: Caption
evidence.captionHint: One line on what it shows.
evidence.removeBody: It leaves the step and the plan. The plan's history keeps that it was there.
evidence.wrongType: Hub takes PNG, JPEG or WebP pictures and MP4 or WebM clips.
evidence.tooLarge: Too large: a picture up to 8 MB, a clip up to 40 MB.
evidence.wrongKind: A clip is Video; a picture is Before or After.
evidence.drop: Drop a picture or clip here

video.title: The plan on video
video.hint: Each chapter lights its phase on the map while it plays.
video.none: No explainer video yet. Hams can make one from the plan and its phases.
video.intro: Claude writes the script from the plan and its phases on your machine, then Hams makes the video in the style and voice you pick.

whiteboard: A hand draws the phases, writes, and circles the spoken word
slides: A slide per phase, points appearing with the narration
motion: Shapes and icons that explain each phase
kinetic: The words are the show, moving to the rhythm
data: Progress, effort and phases as charts and counters
mixed: Claude picks the best style for each phase

google: Gemini TTS, the default. High quality and fast; needs the internet.
hams: An Egyptian model on the graphics card. Nothing leaves the machine; slower.

video.googleNotice: With the Google voice, the script's text is sent to Google to make the voice. Nothing else leaves your machine.
video.localNotice: With the Hams voice or no narration, nothing leaves your machine.
video.noFolder: Hams' folder is not one of this project's folders. Add it (for example F:/tools/hams) in the project's settings, then ask again.
video.noDevice: No device runs Claude here. Connect one from the panel first.
video.asked: Asked for. It starts when Claude's queue reaches it on {device}.

stages.script: Claude writes the script from the plan
stages.attach: Adding it to the plan with chapters and captions

video.failed: The video was not made: the run ended without it.
video.outdated: The plan changed after this video (revision {n}).
video.previous: The video before this request still plays until the new one is ready.

draft.proposedHint: Read it, then save it to Planning, develop it in the chat, or run it.
draft.savedToast: Saved as {key}. It is a draft plan in Planning now.
draft.runTip: Puts the plan in the chat in Execute. Nothing runs until you send it.

studio.title: Idea Studio
studio.subtitle: Describe the idea as you would to a colleague. Claude checks whether it already exists in Hub and in the code, researches it, and brings you one organised report: suggestions, a flow, sources and a draft plan.
studio.label: Your idea
studio.placeholder: For example: let agents see a customer's whole booking history in one place, with refunds, changes and every message we sent them…
studio.startTip: Starts a new chat in Plan, which reads only. Nothing is created until you accept the report.
studio.noDevice: Choose a device and a folder for Claude first.
studio.noPanel: The Idea Studio needs the Claude panel, which is not available on this page.
studio.examplesLabel: Or start from one of these
examples: A weekly digest for the owner of what moved, what is stuck and what needs a decision
Let a customer change their flight date from the site without calling us
Warn the team before a supplier's credentials expire

describe.title: Describe it
describe.body: In your own words, one prompt. No forms.

check.title: It checks what exists
check.body: Hub's cards and documents, and the code itself, with how much of the idea each one already covers.

research.title: It researches and suggests
research.body: How others solve it, with sources, then suggestions, alternatives, a flow and a draft plan.

accept.title: You decide
accept.body: Refine it in the conversation, then accept it into Hub as an idea, and turn it into a plan.

studio.researchingHint: Everything here is something Claude really read or opened. The report appears here when it is done.
studio.stopped: The research stopped before a report
studio.stoppedHint: Claude may have asked something in the conversation, or the turn was stopped. You can let it carry on.
studio.continuePrompt: Carry on with the research where you stopped, and send the whole report with propose_idea.
studio.acceptHint: Saves it as an idea in Planning, linked to the cards it matched. Nothing else is created.
studio.acceptedToast: Saved as {key}, an idea in Planning.
studio.stepsHint: A draft: it becomes a plan only when you turn the accepted idea into one.
studio.noMatches: Nothing like it was found in Hub or in the code.
studio.composerPlaceholder: Ask Claude to change the report…

refine.label: Make it simpler
refine.prompt: Make the idea simpler: keep the smallest version that still solves the problem, and send the whole updated report with propose_idea.

refine.label: Research deeper
refine.prompt: Research deeper, with more sources and how good products solve this, and send the whole updated report with propose_idea.

refine.label: More alternatives
refine.prompt: Give me more alternatives and compare them, then send the whole updated report with propose_idea.

refine.label: Plan in detail
refine.prompt: Make the draft plan detailed: smaller steps, each with its role, and send the whole updated report with propose_idea.

note.title: Idea Studio report
note.here: The whole report is on this page.

chat.title: Conversation
chat.typeWhileBusy: Claude is working… write your next request: it goes as soon as this turn ends
chat.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.waitingYou: Claude is waiting for your answer in the conversation before it goes on

studio.staleHint: The report changed after you accepted it. Update the idea so it holds this version.
studio.applyPrompt: Apply this suggestion to the idea: «{title}». Keep the rest as it is, and send the whole updated report with propose_idea.
studio.answersPrompt: My answers to your open questions. Work them into the report, take the answered ones out of the questions, and send the whole updated report with propose_idea:

deck.otherHint: An answer in your own words
deck.takeRecommendedTip: Picks the recommended option on every question you have not answered, and leaves your answers as they are.
deck.allAnswered: Every question is answered. Review them or send them.

missing.title: This session was not found
missing.body: Its chat may have been deleted, or belongs to another member or browser.

studio.queueFull: One request is already waiting. Cancel it or wait for the turn to end.
studio.manualHint: Know the idea and need no research?

planStudio.title: Plan Studio
planStudio.subtitle: Say what you want to plan, or pick an idea. Claude reads what Hub and the code already have, weighs the order and the risks, and brings you a plan you can save, refine or run.
planStudio.label: What to plan
planStudio.placeholder: For example: move refunds to the new payment gateway without stopping bookings…
planStudio.ideaPlaceholder: Anything to add to the idea: a deadline, a limit, what matters most… (optional)
planStudio.startTip: Starts a new chat in Plan, which reads only. Nothing is saved until you save the plan.
planStudio.noDevice: Choose a device and a folder for Claude first.
planStudio.noPanel: The Plan Studio needs the Claude panel, which is not available on this page.
planStudio.fromIdea: Or start from an open idea
planStudio.examplesLabel: Or start from one of these
examples: Launch hotel bookings with one supplier, in four weeks
Move the secrets out of the tracked .env and rotate them before launch
A daily financial close with alerts when money does not add up

describe.title: Say what to plan
describe.body: A topic in your words, or an idea from Planning.

read.title: It reads what exists
read.body: Hub's plans, ideas, cards and documents, and the code the topic touches.

draft.title: It drafts the plan
draft.body: Goal and approach, ordered steps with who and how big, checks, risks and a flow.

decide.title: You decide
decide.body: Answer its questions, refine it in the conversation, then save it to Planning.

planStudio.stopped: Claude stopped before proposing a plan
planStudio.stoppedHint: It may have asked something in the conversation, or the turn was stopped. You can let it carry on.
planStudio.continuePrompt: Carry on where you stopped, and propose the whole plan with propose_plan.
planStudio.saveHint: Saves a draft plan with these steps in Planning. Nothing else is created.
planStudio.saveFromIdeaHint: Turns the idea {key} into this plan, so the two stay linked.
planStudio.savedToast: Saved as {key}, a plan in Planning.
planStudio.staleHint: The plan changed after you saved it. Updating rewrites its text and its steps.
planStudio.runTip: Puts the plan in the panel's box, in Execute. It runs only when you send it.
planStudio.sizeHint: Small is hours, medium a day or two, large most of a week.
planStudio.draftNote: A draft: it becomes a plan in Planning only when you save it.
planStudio.composerPlaceholder: Ask Claude to change the plan…

refine.label: Smaller steps
refine.prompt: Break the plan into smaller steps, each one task with its role and size, and propose the whole updated plan with propose_plan.

refine.label: Faster path
refine.prompt: Find the fastest path that still removes the biggest risk first; cut or defer what can wait. Propose the whole updated plan with propose_plan.

refine.label: More checks
refine.prompt: Add the checks that prove each part works, and the risks you did not list yet. Propose the whole updated plan with propose_plan.

refine.label: Draw the flow
refine.prompt: Add a small flow diagram of how the plan's parts connect, and propose the whole updated plan with propose_plan.

planStudio.answersPrompt: My answers to your open questions. Work them into the plan, take the answered ones out of the questions, and propose the whole updated plan with propose_plan:
